description: `directives show` reads a project's standing directives file straight off disk (directives.py's `read`): a file written with an `until:` header plus a blank line plus the body. `MULTIVERSE_DIRECTIVES` (directives.py's `directives_root`) is redirected to a scenario-seeded directory so the file can be pre-written statically, the same way other scenarios redirect CODEX_HOME to a fake account config dir. A second project with no file at all reads as 'no standing directives.' in the same invocation (projects omitted -> every configured project, cwd resolves to none since cwd is outside both).
